evidence: Gifford (groin) is questionable to return to Monday's game against the Commanders, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
Bradford (knee) was designated to return from injured reserve by the Seahawks on Monday, John Boyle of the team's official website reports.
Jamison Hensley details Lamar Jackson's injury status with the Ravens
Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed with reporters Monday that Arroyo will miss "significant time" due to a shoulder injury that he picked up during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Turner is expected to go on injured reserve after sustaining a groin strain in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.
Cowboys Pro Bowl returner Turpin sustained a rib injury on his opening kickoff return after he was tackled awkwardly.
